content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR IHBT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR IHBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled on different dates for different positions, ranging from 21 September 2026 to 24 September 2026. Candidates should check the specific date for their desired post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by CSIR IHBT?
faq.answer: CSIR IHBT has released a total of 16 vacancies for various project positions through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the CSIR IHBT recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification varies by post, ranging from B.Sc. in Agriculture/Horticulture/Biology to M.Sc. in various science disciplines, B.Tech., M.Pharma, and Ph.D. in Chemistry.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CSIR IHBT project positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 40 years, with relaxations applicable for SC/ST/PwBD/Women and OBC categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the CSIR IHBT project positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 20,000/- to Rs. 58,000/- per month, plus applicable House Rent Allowance (HRA) for most positions.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for CSIR IHBT recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CSIR IHBT project positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews will be conducted at the CSIR Institute of Himalayan Bioresource Technology (CSIR IHBT) located in Palampur, Himachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates), and a duly filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, these are contractual positions. The job type is mentioned as 'Contractual' in the official notification.
